findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "白馬 2027" (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "六個雪場 由北到南" (screen 5, 100% over a picture); "八方尾根" (screen 6, 58% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "八方尾根"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
